verdict.rationale: Neon's security page on AI use says only your schema, not your data, is shared with the SQL Editor's AI agent (Amazon Bedrock), and its chat assistance avoids ingesting PII. That limits how much of your data reaches AI models, but it never mentions model training or offers an opt-out. missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment for customer data, a user-facing control or opt-out for AI features, coverage of other AI surfaces such as AI Gateway traffic, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: we share your database schema with the AI agent, but no actual data is shared
public sources such as Neon docs and GitHub repos without ingesting PII.
